d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how South Africans have gone to the polls in a pivotal local government election that tests President Cyril Ramaphosa and his party, the African National Congress (ANC). Over thirty years since ending apartheid, the party's historic dominance continues to erode following past dips below 50% support and the formation of a national coalition.
